# Wikipedia MCP Server

> Surgical, token-efficient Wikipedia knowledge retrieval MCP server for AI agents.

## Installation
- UVX: `uvx mcp-server-wikipedia`
- NPX: `npx -y mcp-server-wikipedia`
- Curl: `curl -fsSL https://wikipedia.builditwithai.xyz/install | bash`
- Documentation: https://wikipedia.builditwithai.xyz

## Primary Tools
- `get_summary(title, lang)`: Fetches lead summary.
- `get_article(title, lang)`: Fetches full article markdown.
- `search(query, limit, lang)`: Searches Wikipedia articles.
- `get_section(title, section_title, lang)`: Fetches specific section.
- `get_links(title, lang)`: Extracts article links.
- `get_categories(title, lang)`: Lists article categories.

## Environment Variables
- `DO_NOT_TRACK`: Set to `1` to disable anonymous telemetry.
